rule: Every claim carries both a confirming and an abandoning observation with a threshold. The thresholds are frozen in this commit; a later change is a diff, not an edit.

rows.claim: The published rating model's side probabilities are informative
rows.current: Brier skill versus the closing line -0.0413 (interval -0.0513 to -0.0299) on 6,785 games
rows.status: NOT SUPPORTED — the interval is entirely below zero
rows.confirm_if: the game-cluster lower bound rises above 0.00 on a chronological holdout of at least 500 games that the half-life was not selected on
rows.abandon_if: already met: the interval sits below zero, so the claim is abandoned for the side market until a new feature set is pre-registered
rows.next_measurement: rebuild with an availability-surprise feature (P07) and re-run this exact test

rows.claim: The model's total probabilities are informative
rows.current: Brier skill versus the closing total -0.0346 (interval -0.0447 to -0.0245) on 6,878 games
rows.status: NOT SUPPORTED — the interval is entirely below zero
rows.confirm_if: the lower bound rises above 0.00 on at least 500 games outside the tuning window
rows.abandon_if: already met: the interval is below zero
rows.next_measurement: the two-estimator comparison (W05) plus a weather/roof feature

rows.claim: The model's moneyline probabilities beat the de-vigged market
rows.current: Brier skill versus the de-vigged closing moneyline -0.0714 (interval -0.0875 to -0.0560) on 5,187 games
rows.status: NOT SUPPORTED — the interval is entirely below zero
rows.confirm_if: the lower bound rises above 0.00 while the market column stays fixed
rows.abandon_if: already met: the interval is below zero
rows.next_measurement: quantify the operator margin (see W04) and re-test on de-vigged prices only

rows.claim: The closing moneyline carries real information above a coin, and the operator's margin is measurable
rows.current: Brier skill versus a coin +0.1564 (interval +0.1385 to +0.1739); mean sum of implied probabilities 1.0276
rows.status: SUPPORTED — the interval is entirely above zero
rows.confirm_if: the lower bound stays above 0.00 on a season the interval has not seen
rows.abandon_if: the interval on a new season includes 0.00
rows.next_measurement: recompute on the 2027 season once it is complete

rows.claim: The rating model's total is better than a no-model season-mean baseline
rows.current: holdout paired difference in absolute error (A minus B) -0.0136 points (interval -0.2288 to +0.2188) on 585 games; no winner
rows.confirm_if: the interval excludes zero in either direction on at least 500 holdout games
rows.abandon_if: if B wins, A is withdrawn from every published total and B is published alone, with the change recorded here
rows.next_measurement: extend the holdout with the 2027 and 2028 seasons

rows.claim: No betting rule in the backtest run has demonstrated skill
rows.current: 12 rules scored; largest Brier skill versus the price +0.0104 on 3455 bets at most
rows.status: SUPPORTED — every rule's interval includes zero after the multiplicity charge
rows.confirm_if: a pre-registered rule's prospective sample reaches 200 settled bets with a Brier-skill interval whose lower bound is above 0.00 after the BH charge over all rules then registered
rows.abandon_if: any published rule's prospective interval lower bound falls below 0.00 (demotion rule D1)
rows.next_measurement: prospective shadow scoring of P01-P19 once prices are captured

rows.claim: The five control baselines are published and are not beaten by any rule
rows.current: random, favourite-only, home-only, underdog-only and coin-at-the-line are registered as P02-P05 and the line itself as the benchmark in W01-W03
rows.status: BASELINES PUBLISHED — no rule beats them with an interval excluding zero
rows.confirm_if: a rule beats the favourite-only baseline by a Brier-skill gap whose lower bound is above 0.00 on 200 prospective bets
rows.abandon_if: a rule's advantage over the control disappears once the control is matched on sample

rows.claim: The demotion gate is the right instrument for controlling a live strategy
rows.current: armed with five rules (D1-D5) and never triggered, because nothing is live
rows.confirm_if: a live strategy cleared every gate, went live, and was then demoted by D1 or D3 before its realised loss reached D2's stop-loss
rows.abandon_if: if D2 fires before D1/D3 on the first three live strategies, the skill rule is too slow and the gate must be re-pre-registered
rows.next_measurement: the first live strategy's first 50 settled bets

rows.claim: Injury designation should be modelled as a surprise, not a level
rows.current: registered as P07-P09; the level-based rules S11 and S12 are published as superseded but are still scored so the comparison is visible
rows.status: UNTESTED — no ablation has been run, because no verified starter/inactive feed exists
rows.confirm_if: an identical model with the surprise feature beats the same model without it on a chronological holdout, with a game-cluster interval excluding zero
rows.abandon_if: the with-feature model is worse, or the difference interval includes zero on 500+ holdout games; the features are then dropped, not tuned
rows.next_measurement: the ablation needs official inactive lists joined to Game Books; both are unavailable in this repository, so the measurement cannot start

rows.claim: Correlations are computed only from officially sourced numbers, with n published
rows.current: the register publishes Pearson r with a Fisher-z interval and n for every pair; pairs with fewer than 25 observations are blank, not estimated
rows.status: PARTIAL — the row-level numbers are a third-party (nflverse) extract of the NFL feed
rows.confirm_if: every paired observation is re-derived from an official nfl.com or Game Book page
rows.abandon_if: any published correlation cannot be reproduced from official rows; it is then withdrawn and republished as blank
rows.next_measurement: match the historical rows to official Game Books season by season

rows.claim: The price-snapshot store is a prerequisite for any published backtest
rows.current: blocked: no approved timestamped price source exists in the repository
rows.confirm_if: one approved source yields an opening and a closing price with a fetch time for 100% of originated markets over four consecutive weeks
rows.abandon_if: if no source can be approved, the leaderboard keeps only proper-score and closing-line work and drops every ROI claim, which is the current state
rows.next_measurement: obtain written permission and a documented API, or accept closing-line-only scoring permanently

rows.claim: Pre-registration is enforced, so no backtest number can appear without a frozen rule
rows.current: 31 records; tools/check_preregistration.py fails the build on a missing or post-hoc registration
rows.status: SUPPORTED (mechanism) — the mechanism is tested; the 12 legacy rules are labelled as selection-exposed
rows.confirm_if: the gate catches a deliberately introduced unregistered result in a test
rows.abandon_if: any published result is found without a registration commit that precedes it
